newsitem.title: USA: ACC Corp says solid growth will continue.
newsitem.headline: ACC Corp says solid growth will continue.

text.p: ACC Corp said Wednesday it expects solid financial growth to continue through 1997 as it looks toward expanding in the U.S. and Western Europe, and toward making "selected acquisitions."
The company said it expects further growth in the U.S.in 1997 as the installation of one new long distance switch and three new local service switches are completed.
But the company said it anticipates retail pricing pressure in the U.K. market as it becomes more competitive.
The company reported earnings per share of $0.23 for the first quarter ended March 31 versus $0.03 for the same period a year ago.
